newsitem.title: USA: Evergreen Media to buy Texas radio stations for $83.5 million.
newsitem.headline: Evergreen Media to buy Texas radio stations for $83.5 million.

text.p: Evergreen Media Corp. said Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement to buy two Dallas-area radio stations from Bonneville International Corp. for $83.5 million.
The company said it will acquire KZPS-FM 92.5 MHZ in Dallas and KDGE-FM 94.5 MHZ in Denton.
The transaction is scheduled to close in the fourth quarter, pending approval from the Federal Communications Commission, the company said.
In February, Evergreen announced plans to form Chancellor Media Corp. through a merger with Chancellor Broadcasting Co.
